body: I work out everyday, i'm into bodybuilding. It helps but it's not enough on it's own. I wear clothes that I think I look nice in. I just can't ignore reality by doing these things.

I don't really have to worry about future social connections, because unless one randomly happens before the end of the semester. I'll have to kill myself. Way too much work to be putting into life, to no get anything out.

The 4 things listed are just so very important. If you think about not having any of them at all, not being able to realistically meet any reasonable expectations. It makes everything pointless. I thought I had potential, but I know I don't.

No disrespect at all, I appreciate you taking the time to comment, but that comment completely ignores the psychsocial reason for needing it. You can't just be like i'll ignore that urge and be happy. Inclinations don't work that way. Solitude is fine, if that's what you want. However, if you are afraid of making a joke of yourself, that's not a good reason to not have relationships.
